message.content: {"note_claim": "Law enforcement have not identified the shooter nor provided characteristics of race or nationality of the suspect.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Asked whether authorities have any name at all for the person or a name they are looking at behind the scenes which they could not release to public, Perez replied, “No.”", "reason": "The CNN live page shows the police chief saying authorities have no name for the person of interest, and the AG warning against speculation, substantiating that the shooter was not identified."}

parsed.note_claim: Law enforcement have not identified the shooter nor provided characteristics of race or nationality of the suspect.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Asked whether authorities have any name at all for the person or a name they are looking at behind the scenes which they could not release to public, Perez replied, “No.”
parsed.reason: The CNN live page shows the police chief saying authorities have no name for the person of interest, and the AG warning against speculation, substantiating that the shooter was not identified.
